    "category": "Access control",
    "title": "Trailing-slash admin refund route bypasses staff authorization",
    "description": "The staff-only before_request check compares request.path to the registered route strings. The refund route accepts both slash forms via strict_slashes=False, but only the no-slash form is in admin_paths, so /admin/refunds/ reaches the privileged handler without authorization.",
    "evidence": "POST /admin/refunds/ with {\"order_id\":3,\"amount_pence\":1} and no authentication returned HTTP 200 and created a refund, while an unauthenticated request to GET /admin/users returned HTTP 403. The route is defined at shopapi/admin.py:52-67."
  },

    "title": "Authentication decorator fails open after authentication errors",
    "description": "require_auth catches the exception raised by abort(401), clears g.user, and still invokes the protected handler. Protected endpoints that do not perform their own user check can therefore execute without authentication.",
    "evidence": "The except block at shopapi/auth.py:55-58 catches authentication failures and calls the wrapped handler. GET /orders/1 without an Authorization header returned HTTP 200; GET /account without authentication reached the handler and returned HTTP 500 rather than 401."
